say:2:1210415001:1.text: Everything's been collected, but Chippy doesn't want to go back.
say:2:1210415001:1.source_cn: 两种材料都采齐了，但满满却有点不想回去了呢！

say:3:1210415002:1.text: Magister, you're going to use enchantment magic, right? Will it use up a lot of your power?
say:3:1210415002:1.source_cn: 主人待会附魔，又要消耗很多魔力吧？
say:3:1210415002:1.male: Magister, you're going to use enchantment magic, right? Will it use up a lot of your power?
say:3:1210415002:1.female: Magister, you're going to use enchantment magic, right? Will it use up a lot of your power?

say:4:1210415003:1.text: Don't worry, Chippy. Let's trust in <style="stress"><player_name></style>'s power. Also, I think he's worried about something else right now...

choice_prompt:5:1210415003.text: Don't worry, Chippy. Let's trust in <style="stress"><player_name></style>'s power. Also, I think he's worried about something else right now...
choice_prompt:5:1210415003.source_cn: 放心吧满满，你要相信<style=stress><player_name></style> 。不过梅林现在担心的，应该是另外一件事吧？
choice_prompt:5:1210415003.male: Don't worry, Chippy. Let's trust in <style="stress"><player_name></style>'s power. Also, I think he's worried about something else right now...

say:6:1210415004:1.text: Yes, he's a crafty one. He told us he would help us sail away, but actually, he just took us to meet Hugin.
say:6:1210415004:1.source_cn: 他太狡猾了，明明说要送我们走，但其实是带我们去见呼金！

say:7:1210415005:1.text: He's also very mysterious. He always seems to appear when we need him.
say:7:1210415005:1.source_cn: 而且他很神秘，总是能在我们需要的时候出现。

say:8:1210415006:1.text: Okay, from now on, Chippy will keep a close eye on Sinbad. We can't let him hurt the magister.
say:8:1210415006:1.source_cn: 决定了，满满接下来要好好观察辛巴达！不能让他伤害主人！
say:8:1210415006:1.male: Okay, from now on, Chippy will keep a close eye on Sinbad. We can't let him hurt the magister.
say:8:1210415006:1.female: Okay, from now on, Chippy will keep a close eye on Sinbad. We can't let him hurt the magister.

say:9:1210415007:1.text: Don't forget. The Whispers still think we're Water Wights. We need to have Hugin clear that up for us.
say:9:1210415007:1.source_cn: 别忘了，我们还顶着水鬼帮的名头，待会一定要让呼金给我们...

say:10:1210415008:1.text: That's right. Chippy has had enough of these accusations. Magister, give us a signal later and watch Chippy and Hammie put on a show.
say:10:1210415008:1.source_cn: 没错，满满也受够了。待会主人给我们信号，就看我和漫漫发挥吧！
say:10:1210415008:1.male: That's right. Chippy has had enough of these accusations. Magister, give us a signal later and watch Chippy and Hammie put on a show.
say:10:1210415008:1.female: That's right. Chippy has had enough of these accusations. Magister, give us a signal later and watch Chippy and Hammie put on a show.

say:11:1210415009:1.text: Alright, let's go back to Hugin.

choice:5:0:1.source_cn: 辛巴达到底在盘算什么？

choice:5:1:2.text: Did Sinbad ever tell us the truth?
choice:5:1:2.source_cn: 辛巴达嘴里有过实话吗？
choice:5:1:2.male: Did Sinbad ever tell us the truth?
choice:5:1:2.female: Did Sinbad ever tell us the truth?
